verdict.rationale: Sierra lets builders define step-by-step agent workflows and journeys, either as code or no-code, with 'sophisticated logic', guardrails, and configurable hand-off rules. These behave like conditional logic that runs during customer conversations, and Live Assist can start workflows from inside a conversation. None of this is documented as a general rules engine where an event triggers an action automatically, so it only glancingly matches the story. Missing for 10: an explicit event-trigger/rule-definition capability, documentation of supported event types and automated actions outside the conversation flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
